findings.reason: the remedy must sit on the path the reviewer and the promotion actually use (a shared refusal consulted by the check-manifest audit, as `review_status_refusal` already is), or §16 does not stop the very defect its cited evidence names, and the claimless record continues to reach the store and the committed tree.
findings.text: §16 has the refusal "`store_review` refuses a run review whose findings list holds an entry that states no claim … so the reviewing worker rewrites the record and stores it again", but `store_review` writes only the host staging store (`review_path` at review.py:1876 routes through `review_store_root`, ~/.config/reckon/crew/reviews), whereas the record §16's own Why cites sits in the committed tree at docs/state/imas-efit/reviews/run/r-20261015T162752320759-containment-frac-reachable/ and carries `times_source: run-record` plus `dispatched_at`/`completed_at`, fields only `store_committed_review` writes (review.py:2662-2714, reached from promotion.py:1264); and a reviewing worker bypasses `store_review` altogether, writing its record directly into the store paths its dispatch grants — a documented bypass (reports.py:1647) that check-manifest already compensates for by re-applying the store's status refusal through `_review_record_status_findings` / `_reviewer_store_records` (reports.py:1637, 1549). The refusal as specified therefore never fires for the writer that produced the incident, nor for the committed write that filed it.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — verified that `FINDING_CLAIM_FIELDS` (review.py:156) and `finding_claim` (review.py:159) read exactly `text,summary,detail,title`, that `_unreadable_record_items` (obligation_snapshot.py:545) emits the quoted remedy verbatim, and that the cited incident record resolves on disk at `imas-efit/docs/state/imas-efit/reviews/run/r-20261015T162752320759-containment-frac-reachable/r-20261015T171352888862-review-of-containment-frac-reachable-ff20d27d6c7b.json` with `status=parsed` and a `message`-keyed finding.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §16 and §17 each name a declared negative control ("with the refusal removed, the claimless record is stored"; "with the single remedy restored, the claimless case says 'writer finishes'"), both logged under the run directory, and both measures are falsifiable.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — both sections write their negative controls under the node's run directory and their gate logs there, not to a session scratchpad or a node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test filenames and both sections' symbols describe mechanisms ("a claimless review is refused at store", "an unreadable review duty names its fault") with no plan, stage or ticket label.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §16 places the refusal on `store_review`, which neither wrote the record its own Why cites nor is reached by the reviewing worker that produced it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §16 carries one deliverable (refuse a claimless run review at store time) and §17 one (name an unreadable record's fault in its duty).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the three units under review declare no missing dependency; §17's serialisation on the seat-plan section that also edits `obligation_snapshot.py` is recorded in followup f-erkc-017 ("runs after that lands"), and §16 declares itself independent.
